opportunities.name: Notes attack mage
opportunities.objective: Test notes attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Stage Presence adds 25 attack range and AP-scaled magic damage per note; casting near allies and hitting Encore through them prepares a long-range empowered attack. Nashor supports subsequent attacks and Lich Bane adds one spell-triggered magic packet, but notes are consumed on the first attack.
opportunities.requiredState: Several allies near casts and notes banked before attacking.
opportunities.failure: After note consumption she loses that temporary range and becomes exposed.
opportunities.test: Compare first note attack and subsequent two attacks separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Every attack does not retain maximum notes or permanently extended range.

opportunities.name: Slow-to-stun charge support
opportunities.objective: Test slow-to-stun charge support against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Beat Drop upgrades slow to root and immobilization to stun; Rylai tests providing a slow on the damage event, while echoed E offers a second hit. Helia stores damage and WW shielding consumes it for healing; Mandate benefits confirmed immobilizations rather than arbitrary slows.
opportunities.requiredState: Echo E available and allies remain inside Surround Sound.
opportunities.failure: Rylai processing order might not upgrade a single E; weak AP reduces damage.
opportunities.test: Compare single E, echoed E and pre-slowed E, then measure WW healing.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rylai's same-hit status ordering needs testing instead of assuming unconditional single-cast root.

ruledOut.reason: Every attack does not retain maximum notes or permanently extended range.

unknowns: Proc effectiveness and ordering need a controlled current-patch test; source statFormula IDs and helper records do not establish live dispatch.

builds.name: Notes attack mage
builds.summary: Test notes attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test notes attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Stage Presence adds 25 attack range and AP-scaled magic damage per note; casting near allies and hitting Encore through them prepares a long-range empowered attack. Nashor supports subsequent attacks and Lich Bane adds one spell-triggered magic packet, but notes are consumed on the first attack.
testPlan: Required state: Several allies near casts and notes banked before attacking.
Compare first note attack and subsequent two attacks separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: After note consumption she loses that temporary range and becomes exposed.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Every attack does not retain maximum notes or permanently extended range.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Seraphine spurs her nearby allied champions in song, granting them [(0.2 + (0.0002) × AP) × (0.4)] Move Speed, herself [0.2 + (0.0002) × AP] decaying Move Speed and both [(60 / 80 / 100 / 120 / 140 + (0.2) × AP) × (1)] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

If Seraphine is already Shielded, she calls out to her allies to join her, restoring [8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16]% missing Health to them after a [2.5] second delay.

Seraphine unleashes a heavy soundwave, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to enemies in a line and Slowing them by [99]% for [1.1 / 1.2 / 1.3 / 1.4 / 1.5] seconds.

Enemies that are already Slowed are Rooted instead, and Immobilized enemies are Stunned.

Seraphine projects a pure note, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage, increased against champions and monsters by the target's missing Health percentage up to [(60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.4) × AP) × (1.75)] damage below [25]% Health.

Every third basic Ability Seraphine casts will echo, automatically casting a second time.

Additionally, Seraphine draws inspiration from the music within her allies, creating a Note for each nearby ally whenever she casts an Ability. For each Note, Seraphine's Attacks gain [25] Attack Range and deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(4 → 25; raw flags preserved) + (0.04) × AP] magic damage and consume the Notes.

Seraphine takes the stage, projecting a captivating force that Charms for [1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75] seconds and deals [150 / 200 / 250 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Any champions struck (including allies) become part of the performance, extending the range of this Ability. Allied champions gain maximum Notes.
